## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change belongs in Community.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] End-to-end `ctkf-community init` and `verify`
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, private CTKF source, or Pro assets
- [ ] License, compatibility, and security effects documented

## Claim boundary

State what was not tested. Do not represent local or simulated evidence as real
production proof.
